aimer.syncHint: Use the same source when importing a sheet again. AimerHQ matches date, customer and job type: insert new rows, update changes and skip unchanged rows. Records outside the current range are retained.
aimer.terminalBatch: This batch is complete and read-only. Import the sheet into the same source again to compare new, changed and unchanged records in a new batch.
aimer.columnWarning: Confirmed preset: column I (index 8) contains company gross wages; column H is ignored. Blank costs mean zero. POS/Kiosk Installation uses installation rates; remaining work uses on-site rates. Verify mappings if the sheet layout changes.

aimer.rules: Company wages are used directly; missing wages follow confirmed rules, with only wages divided between participants. Expenses stay separate; withholding is estimated at 20% of wages. Examples and totals are excluded. Ambiguous rows block submission. Reading the same source again can update existing records.
